projects.name: Dining Management
projects.shortDescription: A role-based meal and finance management frontend for shared dining systems, supporting meal booking, scheduling, templates, deadlines, and monthly operations.

details.description: A full-featured frontend for a shared dining management platform built with Next.js App Router, React, and TypeScript. It supports role-based workflows for members, managers, and admins to manage meals, schedules, templates, deadlines, finance, and monthly operational lifecycle data.
challenges: Implementing strict role-based access and protected routes across member, manager, and admin areas
Designing deadline-aware booking flows with clear UI states for unavailable or expired actions
Coordinating schedule generation, repair, and editing workflows for daily and monthly operations
Keeping complex dashboard data synchronized using TanStack Query with reliable invalidation strategies
Managing timezone-sensitive meal and month logic for Dhaka-based operational cutoffs
Building resilient API integration with Axios interceptors for auth headers and normalized error handling
futurePlans: Add richer monthly reporting exports for finance and meal analytics
Introduce notification workflows for deadline reminders and schedule updates
Extend admin auditing for role changes, account state transitions, and rollback actions
Improve advanced filtering and search across members, registrations, and historical records
Enhance offline-tolerant UX patterns for unstable network conditions in operational environments

projects.name: StudyMate
projects.shortDescription: StudyMate is a platform that helps students find compatible study partners based on subject, experience level, and preferred study mode (Online, In-Person, Hybrid).

details.description: A student collaboration platform that connects learners with compatible study partners based on subject, experience level, and study mode preferences, featuring a smart discovery system and request management.
challenges: Managing partner request state across multiple components
Implementing real-time search and filtering without performance lag
Synchronizing theme toggle across all components and persistent storage
Handling concurrent partner requests and preventing duplicates
Ensuring data consistency between frontend and MongoDB backend
futurePlans: Add real-time chat functionality between matched study partners
Implement study session scheduling with calendar integration
Create a rating and review system for completed study partnerships
Add email notifications for new partner requests and acceptances
Build recommendation algorithm based on past successful matches
Integrate video call functionality for online study sessions
Add study group creation for multiple partners studying together

projects.name: ContestHub
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack creative contest management platform with role-based access and Stripe payments.

details.description: A production-ready contest management platform enabling users to explore, register, and participate in creative contests through secure payments. Features role-based dashboards for admins, contest creators, and participants with JWT authentication and Stripe integration.
challenges: Implementing secure role-based authorization across frontend and backend
Managing complex payment flow with Stripe and ensuring transaction verification
Synchronizing contest approval workflow between creators and admins
Handling state management for multi-role dashboards efficiently
Ensuring payment validation before confirming contest participation
futurePlans: Add real-time notifications for contest updates and winner announcements
Implement leaderboard and ranking system for top participants
Create social sharing features for contests and achievements
Add multi-currency support for international users
Integrate analytics dashboard for contest creators to track performance
Build commenting and feedback system for contests
Add automated email reminders for contest deadlines
Implement portfolio showcase for winners to display their work

projects.name: Skill Bridge
projects.shortDescription: A role-based student-tutor booking platform where students can browse tutors, book sessions, and manage profiles and bookings.

details.description: A full-stack student-tutor booking application with role-based access that lets students discover tutors, book sessions, and manage their profile and booking history. Built with Next.js App Router and a REST client connected to a Node.js/Express backend using PostgreSQL with Prisma.
challenges: Designing role-based route protection and UI behavior for different user types
Managing JWT authentication flow with localStorage token persistence and session handling
Synchronizing booking state across tutor listings, booking forms, and dashboard views
Handling API integration cleanly with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL across environments
Ensuring reliable relational data consistency for users, tutors, and bookings in PostgreSQL with Prisma
futurePlans: Add tutor availability calendar and smarter time-slot conflict prevention
Implement notifications for booking confirmations, reminders, and cancellations
Introduce tutor ratings and reviews after completed sessions
Add advanced tutor filtering by subject, price range, and availability
Provide admin analytics for booking trends and platform activity
Support rescheduling workflows and waitlist management for fully booked tutors
